title: Law to tighten ban on toxic ingredients in period products
summary: This bill clarifies the city's prohibition on selling menstrual and intimate care products containing harmful ingredients like lead, mercury, formaldehyde, talc and fragrance. It requires the Health Department to maintain a public list of products containing restricted substances and to set rules on safe exposure thresholds if the state does so first. The law would take effect 90 days after enactment.
